These files contain a 440 Hz synthetic sine tone lasting 0.75 seconds. They
were generated locally with FFmpeg from its `sine` source, then encoded into
the audio containers accepted by Vostavo. The extra `tone-vorbis.ogg`,
`tone-vorbis.webm`, and `tone-alac.m4a` files cover alternate codecs in those
containers. They contain no human recordings.
